title: The RESEARCH task
description:
When a Containment Unit is in the RESEEARCH state, the Abnormality contained is exhibiting unstable behaviors.

A manager must be present in the Containment Unit for 15 seconds to re-tether the Abnormality, in which certain things about will be learned.

Verdant Abnormalities have 3 research levels, with the last of them possibly triggering an EVOLUTION. 

Please make use of these synthetic researches to observe your Abnormalty's EVOLUTION.
